reviews.depicted_subject: Upstream DNA-document rendering and visual encoding into projected visual tokens for OpticalDNA
reviews.rationale: The final crop shows only the left half of the OpticalDNA pipeline: DNA document generation, patchification, frozen visual encoder, and projector. It omits the crucial prompt/decoder side where the model consumes visual tokens together with task prompts, so the immediate target-model interface is missing. The full source figure on the left visibly contains that correct region; a wider top-row crop covering the full architecture would capture the valid input route.
